content: Womu ɡe Koren bibu bɑ wom kowobun wiruɡii kuɑ. Bɑ ɡu kuɑwɑ kɑ mɔrɔku. Ge wee.

content.text: Gusunɔ, wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni,
wunɛn wɑ̃ɑ yeru tɑ mɑn wɛ̃re.
Nɑ sɛnde, nɑ diirimɔ n wɑ n kɑ du wunɛn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ.
Nɛn ɡɔ̃ru kɑ nɛn wɑsi kpuro nuku dobun kuuki mɔ̀
wunɛ Yinni Gusunɔn sɔ̃, wunɛ wi ɑ wɑ̃ɑ.
Nɛn Yinni, nɛn sinɑ boko!
Bɑɑ kɑ ɡunɔminɔ nu rɑ n wɑ̃ɑ yeru mɔ.
Wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni, ɑ rɑ mɑm de
nu sokunu ko wunɛn yɑ̃ku yerun bɔkuɔ.
Doo nɔɔruɡibɑ be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ wunɛn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ
bɑ nun tɔmɑmɔ bɑɑdommɑ.
Doo nɔɔruɡibɑ be bɑ tɑ̃sɑ wunɛ sɔɔ.
Bɑ rɑ n sɔɔru sɑ̃ɑ bu kɑ sɑ̃ɑru dɑ.
Bɑ̀ n sɑrɔ wɔwɑn di ye bɑ mɔ̀ Yĩresu,
ɑ rɑ de bwii yi koorɑwɑ mi,
kpɑ ɡurɑ yu kɑ ye domɑru nɑɑwɑ.
Nɡe mɛ bɑ dɔɔ bu kɑ Gusunɔ yinnibun Yinni sɑ̃ Siɔniɔ,
nɡe mɛyɑ ben dɑm mu rɑ n sosimɔ ɡbɑbu te sɔɔ.
Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni, ɑ mɑn swɑɑ dɑkio.
Gusunɔ Yɑkɔbun Yinni, ɑ nɛn kɑnɑru nɔɔwɔ.
Yinni, wunɛ wi ɑ sɑ̃ɑ bɛsɛn tɛrɛru,
ɑ wi ɑ ɡɔsɑn wuswɑɑ mɛɛrio.
Nɛn sɔ̃ɔ teerun wɑ̃ɑru wunɛn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ,
tɑ nɛn yɑm tukum wɑ̃ɑrun sɔ̃ɔ dɑbi dɑbinu kere.
N burɑm bo nɑ n wɑ̃ɑ wunɛn sɑ̃ɑ yerun kɔnnɔwɔ,
ye ko nɑ n kɑ wɑ̃ɑ diru mi tɔn kɔ̃sobɑ wɑ̃ɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ, ɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe sɔ̃ɔ.
A mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe tɛrɛru.
Wunɑ ɑ rɑ tɔmbu durom kɑ bɛɛrɛ kue.
Be bɑ sĩimɔ ɡem sɔɔ, ɑ ku rɑ kɑ bu ɡeɑ yinɑri.
Gusunɔ, wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni,
doo nɔɔruɡiiwɑ wi u nun nɑɑnɛ sɑ̃ɑ.
